evidence.detail: .metagame-grid .key-card has display:flex and negative side margins; the .card child uses display:block with width:100% and a ::before pseudo-element for aspect ratio
key-card div wraps a single .card div whose image is a CSS background; the flex may be needed to propagate width correctly given the negative margins
The aspect-ratio hack uses ::before with margin-top:64%; this technique is sensitive to display mode of the parent

triage.notes: The issue is a self-assigned investigation: bakert already observed that removing display:flex breaks the image even with display:block as replacement. Root-cause analysis requires running the page in a browser devtools. Likely the fix is either a comment explaining the necessity or a CSS refactor that makes the layout more explicit (e.g. use explicit height/aspect-ratio instead of the ::before hack).
